name: repeater_manager
title: Repeater manager
description: Your repeaters and room servers on one page: log in (the password stays in memory only), status (battery, uptime, noise floor, signal, packets, airtime), neighbours, telemetry and a remote command line, with graphs of battery, noise floor and traffic over time. Each request goes over the air, one at a time and never retried by itself; commands that change or stop a repeater ask first; status on a timer is off until you set it.
